entities.summary: Adam Bargielski was a Polish Roman Catholic priest. He was born in Kalinowo, Łomża County. He died in the Nazi German Dachau concentration camp. He was beatified by Pope John Paul II on June 13, 1999 and is a member of the 108 Martyrs of World War II.
